provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable camera-relative near-foreground parallax overlay layer for a side-view science-fiction exploration game
Primary request: Create exactly one cave formation overlay: ribbed rock arches and clustered stalactites framing the top and both sides, leaving a large, clearly open center for gameplay readability. No characters, creatures, props, text, UI, borders, or picture frame.
Scene/backdrop: foreground cave silhouettes only, displayed over one perfectly flat, uniform, strongly contrasting chroma-key matte color that appears nowhere in the cave artwork, for deterministic background removal. Use pure bright magenta #FF00FF as the matte. No gradients, shadows, texture, particles, or variation in the matte.
Subject: asymmetric ribbed cave-rock arch across the upper region; layered stalactite clusters of varied lengths; irregular rocky formations entering from the left and right; an unobstructed central gameplay corridor.
Style/medium: authentic 16-bit science-fiction exploration game pixel art in the terrain style “lucinda_cave,” interpreted as broad color groups, limited palette, strong silhouettes, crisp intentional pixel clusters, subtle dark outline, readable side view. No anti-aliasing, painterly blur, vector smoothness, or high-resolution rendering artifacts.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape composition targeted at 960:540. Fill the entire canvas coherently. Keep roughly the central 55–65% visually open and unobstructed. The formations should read as one reusable near-camera parallax layer, not a decorative picture frame. Avoid mirrored symmetry. Avoid matching or repeated motifs at the two horizontal edges.
Color palette: restrained alien-cave hues with near-black plum outlines, deep indigo-violet shadow masses, muted rust and ochre rock midtones, and sparse pale mineral highlights, all separated into broad clusters. The pure #FF00FF matte appears nowhere within the cave forms.
Constraints: output exactly one PNG; clean hard-edged separation between cave formations and matte; no transparency gradients; no text; no watermark; no characters; no repeated edge motif; no enclosed center.
provenance.submitted_prompt: Reusable near cave formation overlay for a side-view science-fiction exploration game: ribbed rock arches and stalactite clusters framing the top and sides, with an open center for gameplay readability. No characters or text.
